summary: Post-market brief: composite risk 52.17, the caution band, regime goldilocks and confidence 0.9167. The score rose 1.61 on the day as the tape broadened sharply: 21 of the 22 sectors and themes closed higher, Networking leading at 3.2657 and Semiconductor Equipment at 2.452, with only EV Supply Chain lower at -0.3651; semiconductor relative strength closed at -0.6076 and MU added 2.6561 while AVGO slipped 1.569. The discount-rate block still binds, macro at 69.67, with the 10-year at 5.26 from 5.24 and the real rate at 2.91 from 2.9, both in the 100.0th percentile, and the curve bear-steepened to 0.37 as the 2-year eased to 4.89. The session's largest new liquidity fact was the reverse repo facility draining to 0.35 from 11.539 on a same-day 2026-10-01 vintage, while the policy path flipped back to a hike at 4.08 against an effective fed funds rate of 3.88. Credit widened again, HY OAS to 3.12 from 3.08, and the VIX advanced to 16.34 from 16.04. Internals stayed inverted, 5 new highs against 16 new lows of 156 names with breadth above the 200-day average at 0.5677. The tracked A-share panel remains frozen at its 2026-09-30 close: XSHG is shut from 2026-10-01 through 2026-10-07 and reopens 2026-10-08.

top_risk_drivers.claim: Cross-asset confirmation is the largest single contribution at 7.5 but reads only 0.5: the dollar is 120.33, the real rate 2.91 and small-cap relative -8.8544 are all still triggering.
The 10Y real rate is 2.91, up from 2.9, in the 100.0th percentile with a risk score of 100.0, keeping macro the heaviest block at 69.67.
The 10Y yield rose to 5.26 from 5.24, the 100.0th percentile of its own history, so the discount-rate constraint is unchanged at the top of the range.
HY OAS widened to 3.12 from 3.08, the fourth-largest contribution at 4.692, with the high-yield risk score at 58.65, so credit is tightening while equities rally.

The reverse repo facility drained to 0.35 from 11.539 on a same-day 2026-10-01 vintage, the 2.33rd percentile with a risk score of 95.35 and a contribution of 3.814: the liquidity cushion shrank by 11.189 in one session.

supporting_signals.claim: The tape broadened sharply: 21 of the 22 sectors and themes closed higher, Networking leading at 3.2657, Semiconductor Equipment at 2.452 and Robotics at 1.8608, with only EV Supply Chain lower at -0.3651.
Leadership rotated back to AI hardware: Semiconductor Equipment added 2.452, Memory 1.8361 and Semiconductors 1.7041 against AI Software at only 0.3239.
Semiconductor relative strength closed at -0.6076, essentially at the benchmark, with Data Centers at 1.3335 and AI Infrastructure at 1.3782.
The tracked mega-caps advanced: MU added 2.6561 to 1093.400024, NVDA 1.5982 to 232.029999, AMD 0.8337 and TSLA 0.6233, while AVGO slipped 1.569.
Volatility stayed contained: the VIX is 16.34 in the 35.56th percentile and realized volatility 10.7492, leaving the block at 25.03.

contradicting_signals.claim: The tape and the cross-asset block diverged: 21 of the 22 sectors and themes closed higher, yet confirmation reads only 0.5 as the dollar at 120.33, the real rate at 2.91 and small-cap relative at -8.8544 keep triggering.
The policy path flipped back to a hike: FedWatch implies 4.08 against an effective fed funds rate of 3.88, while the 2-year eased to 4.89 and the 10Y/2Y spread steepened to 0.37.
Breadth deteriorated even as the tape rose: above the 200-day average slipped to 0.5677 and 5 new highs still trail 16 new lows of 156 names.
Credit widened while equities rallied: HY OAS moved to 3.12 from 3.08 with IG OAS unchanged at 0.84.
The calm in the discount-rate block is partly a vintage artefact: the 10Y observation is dated 2026-09-29 and the credit block 2026-09-30, both behind the fact layer's own 2026-10-01 timestamp.

what_changed_today: Composite risk rose 1.61 to 52.17, still in the caution band, with the goldilocks regime unchanged and model confidence at 0.9167.
The tape broadened to 21 of the 22 sectors and themes higher, with only EV Supply Chain lower at -0.3651; Networking led at 3.2657.
The reverse repo facility drained to 0.35 from 11.539 on a same-day 2026-10-01 vintage, the layer's fifth-largest contribution at 3.814.
The curve bear-steepened: the 10-year rose to 5.26 from 5.24 while the 2-year eased to 4.89 from 4.92, leaving the 10Y/2Y spread at 0.37.
The policy path flipped back to a hike: FedWatch implies 4.08 against an effective fed funds rate of 3.88, reversing the easing bias recorded a session earlier.
Credit widened again: HY OAS to 3.12 from 3.08 with IG OAS steady at 0.84.
Volatility advanced one session to a 2026-09-30 observation: the VIX at 16.34 from 16.04, still short of the fact layer's own 2026-10-01 timestamp.
Internals stayed inverted: above the 200-day average slipped to 0.5677 with 5 new highs against 16 new lows of 156 names.
The tracked A-share panel remains frozen at its 2026-09-30 close: XSHG is shut from 2026-10-01 through 2026-10-07 and reopens 2026-10-08.
watch_next: The Employment Situation release at 2026-10-02, against payrolls of 162.0 on a 2026-08 vintage and unemployment at 4.1.
Whether the hike-priced policy path at 4.08 survives, with the 2-year at 4.89 and the Fed governors split publicly on further tightening.
Whether the reverse repo drain to 0.35 is the start of a reserve-scarcity signal or the unwinding of the quarter-end turn, alongside money market assets falling to 7.89 trillion dollars.
Whether the rates series advances past the 2026-09-29 observation, since the 10-year at 5.26 and HY OAS at 3.12 both predate the fact layer.

Whether the A-share de-rating transmits into the US AI hardware complex while the CN leg cannot confirm: XSHG is shut from 2026-10-01 through 2026-10-07 and reopens 2026-10-08.
The memory channel after Micron's guidance: Memory added 1.8361, Semiconductor Equipment 2.452 and Semiconductors 1.7041 while AVGO fell 1.569.

bull_case.title: Bull case: broad participation absorbs the discount rate
points: Participation is broad: 21 of the 22 sectors and themes closed higher, with Networking at 3.2657 and Semiconductor Equipment at 2.452 leading.
Semiconductor relative strength has returned to near neutral at -0.6076, with Memory up 1.8361 and Semiconductors 1.7041.
Volatility is contained: the VIX is 16.34 in the 35.56th percentile and realized volatility 10.7492, while price sits 6.2592 above its 200-day average.

base_case.title: Base case: the discount rate caps the rally without breaking it
points: The constraint persists: the 10-year at 5.26 and the real rate at 2.91 both sit in the 100.0th percentile, and macro is the heaviest block at 69.67.
The composite is 52.17 with a trend of 1.61, so the tape is absorbing the rate level without repricing risk.
Internals stay inverted but less so: 0.5677 above the 200-day average with 5 new highs against 16 new lows of 156 names, and cross-asset confirmation pinned at 0.5.

bear_case.title: Bear case: the liquidity drain meets a hawkish repricing
